rationale: Taking significant profits on META. Position was 96% of portfolio — an existential concentration risk. META thesis remains intact (Muse AI agent, 3.4M downloads, subscription monetization, zero sell ratings, Cantor target $860), but a single-stock bet of this magnitude is imprudent risk management regardless of conviction. At 261% unrealized gain from $198.53 avg, booking some is correct. Trimming ~38% of shares reduces from 620 to ~385 shares, keeping META as a dominant position while freeing capital for diversification and macro hedges. Exit condition for remaining: thesis breaks if Muse monetization disappoints in Q3 earnings, or if Fed hikes above 5% and multiple compression overrides earnings growth.

Macro hedge via ProShares UltraShort 20+ Year Treasury. The Fed under Warsh hiked 25bp in September and 16/18 officials see another hike in 2026. 10Y UST at 5.22%, 30Y at 5.53% — highest since 2004/2007 respectively. BNP Paribas projects 30Y hitting 5.6%. The structural feedback loop (higher rates → higher debt service → wider deficit → more bond supply → higher rates) has no visible exit valve. $250B bipartisan defense spending adds fiscal pressure. TBT is a 2x inverse of the 20+ Year Treasury — if yields grind higher through Q4 and into Q1 2027, TBT appreciates. Already up 14.4% since June. Exit condition: close if Fed signals a credible pause AND 10Y falls below 4.75%, which would signal the thesis has reversed.

AMD is the highest-quality expression of the CPU+GPU inference bifurcation thesis. Meta signed AMD as lead customer for MI450 accelerators AND Venice CPUs, issuing warrants for up to 160M shares — a structural demand commitment. AMD is up 23.6% since June but still has a clear catalyst path: Venice CPU roadmap for inference workloads, MI450 GPU ramp for training. Unlike Akamai (up 22% in one session on one deal with significant execution risk), AMD has diversified revenue across data center GPU, gaming, and now CPU inference — it's the broadest beneficiary if the workload splits from GPU-only training to GPU training + CPU inference. Exit condition: sell if Nvidia announces inference-optimized silicon that credibly recaptures CPU inference workloads, or if Meta cancels/reduces the Venice CPU commitment, or if AMD misses guidance by >10%.

Arista Networks is the highest-quality expression of AI infrastructure networking — every GPU training cluster, inference farm, and data center requires high-speed Ethernet switching, and Arista dominates with 40%+ market share. $9.6B in supply commitments signals visibility. Unlike chip plays, networking infrastructure is non-fungible (customers don't rip-and-replace switches easily), creating durable recurring revenue. Up 40% YTD but RS line at new highs suggests trend intact. Just added to S&P 100, which creates index-related buying demand. Sizing $20K as a satellite diversifier within the AI infrastructure theme (AMD is my primary expression). Exit condition: sell if AI capex broadly decelerates (two consecutive quarters of hyperscaler capex cuts), or if ANET loses major customer relationships to Cisco/Juniper alternatives.
